description: A clipper with voltage control over where it clips, and a separate full-wave rectifier underneath it

params.text: Sets the voltage the signal is clipped at
Sets how much of the clipping is applied to the signal
Picks which half of the wave is clipped: the positive half, both halves, or the negative half

outputs.text: The rectifier input folded so that it never goes below zero
The rectifier input folded so that it never goes above zero
